run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 covered via search-indexed detail: Commonwealth (AusTender), NSW (NSW eTendering / buy.nsw incl. Transport for NSW and Central Coast Local Health District), Victoria (Buying for Victoria), Queensland (QTenders), WA (Tenders WA), SA (Tenders SA), NT (QTOL) and Tasmania landing/search-indexed listings reviewed. Tier 2 sampled (CSIRO, ANSTO, water GBEs incl. Sydney Water, electricity network GBEs Western Power/Ausgrid, VendorPanel councils). Tier 3 attempted (SAP Ariba Discovery + major-buyer/GBE portals) — no publicly-visible corporate RFx was readable without login; corporate/GBE e-sourcing channels recorded in discovered_sources only. MAJOR LIMITATION THIS RUN (unchanged from recent runs): direct WebFetch to essentially every Australian government, health, water/electricity-GBE, university and e-sourcing domain returned HTTP 403 from the destination site's bot/WAF protection (the egress proxy itself reported healthy). All tender detail below was therefore reconstructed from search-engine indexed snippets rather than the primary notices, so some fields could not be verified to primary-source fidelity and are left null. Prioritised opportunities open or recently published/updated in the last 7 days. No tenders, dates, deliverables or contacts were fabricated; login-gated corporate opportunities were NOT invented.
gaps: WebFetch blocked (HTTP 403 from destination WAF, not the proxy) on EVERY primary source attempted this run: tenders.gov.au (/Atm/Show detail pages), tenders.nsw.gov.au (public.RFT.show detail), decnet.com.au (Defence ATM mirror) and govmarket.com.au (Sydney Water EOI listing). All tender detail below was taken from search-indexed summaries, not primary notice pages.

SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery: public posting board not readable (login/JS-gated + 403 on direct fetch). No Australian corporate RFx captured as a tender this run; portal recorded in discovered_sources only, per registration-gated policy.

Tier 3 major-buyer / GBE e-sourcing portals (Western Power, Ausgrid, Transgrid, NBN Co, BHP, Rio Tinto, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, CBA/Westpac/NAB/ANZ, Telstra/Optus, AGL/Origin): supplier opportunities are registration- or invitation-gated on SAP Ariba/Coupa/TenderLink; no publicly-visible open RFx surfaced this run. Western Power (SAP Ariba) and Ausgrid (TenderLink) confirmed and newly recorded as sources.
EstimateOne, iTWOcx, BidContender (construction subcontractor packages): live package listings require a supplier login; not readable this run. No subcontractor packages captured.

Sydney Water 'Drinking Water Program EPCM Projects' EOI surfaced via GovMarket (a re-publishing aggregator, used only as a discovery signal) — the buyer's own Sydney Water eProcurement portal is recorded as the source of truth. Closing date and full scope could not be verified (GovMarket page returned 403); captured at headline level and flagged in entries_pending_detail.

Central Coast Local Health District RFQ (Gosford Hospital Lift 13 replacement) and Transport for NSW 'Old Nowra Bridge' RFT: closing dates obtained from search-indexed buy.nsw/eTendering snippets; full specification documents, evaluation criteria and contacts not readable this run (403). Captured at headline level.

Victoria, Queensland, WA, SA, NT, ACT core state portals: only landing/index pages were reachable via search; no jurisdiction-specific NEW tender detail could be confirmed to primary-source fidelity this run (403 on all detail pages). Deferred to a future run when portal fetch succeeds.

ANSTO ILWCI+ open RFT was still NOT yet published on AusTender as of this run (only the pre-RFT market-sounding / industry-briefing notice PSC002897/Brief is live; briefing was held 31-Jul-2026 and the open RFT is anticipated early August 2026).

tenders.title: ESTS4000PH6 – Facilities to Support Hobart Class Destroyer (DDG) Aegis Combat System Enhancement
tenders.buyer: Department of Defence (Defence Estate & Infrastructure / DSRG)
tenders.category: Building construction and support and maintenance and repair services
tenders.description: The Department of Defence is seeking, via a multi-stage approach (Invitation to Register / EOI), a suitably qualified designer to deliver facilities supporting the SEA 4000 Phase 6 upgrade of the Hobart Class Destroyer (DDG) Aegis Combat System, with works located in New South Wales and South Australia.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Design and delivery of facilities to support the Hobart Class Destroyer (DDG) Aegis Combat System Enhancement (SEA 4000 Phase 6). This first stage is an Invitation to Register (EOI) to shortlist designers; respondents are assessed on proposed resources and previous performance before progressing to the next stage.
key_deliverables: Facilities to support the SEA 4000 Phase 6 Aegis Combat System Enhancement
Design services delivered across NSW and SA sites
Registration/EOI submission demonstrating resources and previous performance
tenders.scope_of_work: Provision of facilities (design and supporting works) enabling the Hobart Class Destroyer Aegis Combat System Enhancement under SEA 4000 Phase 6, delivered in New South Wales and South Australia. Structured as a multi-stage procurement commencing with an Invitation to Register.
tenders.eligibility: Open approach to market — Invitation to Register (multi-stage); open to suitably qualified designers.
tenders.delivery_location: New South Wales (Sydney) and South Australia
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM AZ6626 / ESTS4000PH6 as indexed by web search (primary ATM page and DECnet mirror both returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch)
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via Tier 1 AusTender search for recent Defence approaches to market; buyer-originated on AusTender. Contact, evaluation weightings, category code and close date confirmed from the search-indexed listing.
tenders.notes: Invitation to Register (first stage of a multi-stage procurement). Evaluation weightings (Proposed resources 50% / Previous performance 50%) and contact via RPS Consulting quoted in the indexed listing. Full ITR documents not readable this run (403).

tenders.title: Welding Aptitude Testing Program
tenders.description: The Australian Submarine Agency is seeking a suitably qualified supplier to design and deliver a Welding Aptitude Testing Program to help identify and develop future welders for the AUKUS submarine enterprise.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Design and delivery of a Welding Aptitude Testing Program that attracts applicants, facilitates hands-on welding construction and assessment activities, determines candidates' suitability for welding careers, and provides career-oriented conversations and participant follow-up. Program targets testing approximately 400 candidates over four years, aimed at individuals with limited to no prior welding experience.
key_deliverables: Attract and recruit program applicants
Facilitate hands-on welding construction and assessment activities
Assess and determine candidates' suitability for careers in welding
Conduct career-oriented conversations and participant follow-up
Test approximately 400 candidates over four years
tenders.scope_of_work: The ASA seeks to engage a supplier to run a testing program for individuals with limited to no welding experience, testing around 400 candidates over four years to determine aptitude and suitability for welding careers supporting the submarine workforce.
tenders.eligibility: Open approach to market (open to all suppliers).
tenders.contract_term: Program spans approximately four years (400 candidates over four years).
tenders.submission_method: Lodge electronically via AusTender using the Lodgement Page link on the ATM notice
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM RFT/WLD/2026 as indexed by web search (primary ATM page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch)
tenders.reasoning: Previously tracked ATM (first seen 2026-07-30); still open and closing 3-Aug-2026 (imminent). Re-confirmed current this run via search. Buyer-originated on AusTender.
tenders.notes: Known/active opportunity; closing imminent (3-Aug-2026, next business day). Contacts and documents not readable (403).

tenders.title: ANSTO Intermediate Level Waste Capacity Increase (ILWCI+) Project – Industry Briefing / Upcoming RFT
tenders.buyer: Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organisation (ANSTO)
tenders.description: ANSTO held an online industry briefing ahead of an upcoming open Request for Tender for the Intermediate Level Waste Capacity Increase (ILWCI+) Project at its Lucas Heights campus – construction of a new intermediate-level waste storage facility. The formal RFT is anticipated to be released via an open approach to market in early August 2026.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Upcoming works (RFT to follow) to construct a new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility within ANSTO's highly regulated operational environment, including significant reinforced concrete structures, specialist fabricated components, mechanical and electrical services, and integration of process systems requiring high standards of quality assurance, traceability, inspection and testing.
key_deliverables: Construction of a new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility (works to be scoped in the forthcoming RFT)
Significant reinforced concrete structures
Specialist fabricated components
Mechanical and electrical services
Integration of process systems with QA, traceability, inspection and testing
tenders.scope_of_work: Construction of a new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility at ANSTO's Lucas Heights campus within a highly regulated nuclear operational environment. The Commonwealth seeks contractors with demonstrated capability in complex industrial, infrastructure, process, energy, manufacturing, defence or similarly regulated projects.
tenders.eligibility: Construction contractors interested in the upcoming RFT; industry briefing was open to interested organisations who registered.
tenders.briefing: Online industry briefing via Microsoft Teams held 31 July 2026 at 2:00 PM (registration was by email to jenksm@ansto.gov.au before 4:00 PM AEST on 29 July 2026). Formal open RFT anticipated early August 2026.
tenders.submission_method: Formal RFT to be released via AusTender open approach to market (watch AusTender in early August 2026)
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM PSC002897/Brief as indexed by web search (primary ATM page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch)
tenders.reasoning: Previously tracked market-sounding notice (first seen 2026-07-30). Industry briefing has now occurred (31-Jul-2026); the open RFT was still not yet published on AusTender as of this run and is expected early August 2026. Buyer-originated on AusTender.
tenders.notes: Market-sounding / pre-RFT notice (not yet a live tender). Briefing (31-Jul-2026) has passed. The open ILWCI+ RFT was NOT yet live on AusTender this run — watch AusTender in early August 2026.
